system.description:
Thin and pale, with oversized, ever-yellow teeth, in a tight red uniform with Elmer stitched in gold on the breast. From afar he looks a gangling youth; up close his taut skin breaks into a web of wrinkles whenever he smiles. He sweats and often excuses himself to find a water-closet, symptoms of the arsenic his "wife" doses him with. Born 611 in Odurn, left at Saint Mark's Orphanage, he found his mother Juliet with the Bluebonnet Fair in 627, murdered a carny out of jealousy, and fled with her to Emberglow, where the Broadalbin took him on in 629. They live in the cellars as man and wife, forever trying to murder each other: she with arsenic, he with "accidents". Now and then one succeeds, and the farce begins again.
Stuck: he serves the hotel, keeps his ear to the floor and, off-shift, tries the Labyrinth again. Until someone new touches his life, he repeats. Passing strange: he was left at the orphanage on the very day the Bellefleur House, Asa Daribondi's "Thought House" in the Obsidian Bastion, was finished.

Losette leans in and whispers a character's close-held secret, and whom he will tell. Sanity DR12. Success: shaken off. Failure: Frightened of Losette for 1 round. Ruin: Frightened and Stupefied for 1 round.

He returns unharmed some while after death, until he finds his bottle or meets the King. He can always find a way out through a hidden passage or a door that was not there; followers gain +1 Corruption. He can reach the Broadalbin, the Whisper Labyrinth's mouth, the Macallister Building and the Dorchester House, but to him they are all the hotel.
